necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, accompanied by episodes of dizziness and a recent event of syncope, corresponding to diagnosis codes I47.1, R42, and R55. A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management. This diagnostic study is essential for evaluating the etiology of the syncope and palpitations to ensure appropriate clinical care.
